name: n7hr1a-cos-delivery
goal: Chief of Staff alerts are submitted and receipted by the Tracker itself; stuck delivery raises a tracker ask that needs no tmux pane

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Live: since 24 Nov 17:24Z every CoS alert nudge stayed unsent in the Claude composer and was submitted only by another sender's Enter (30-MIN tick, tunnel messages, /clear), seen in the chief-of-staff Claude transcripts. Reproduced in a private tmux rig with Claude Code 2.1.332: TrackerTmuxAdapter.nudge returned sent:false and the composer held '[Pasted text #1]' with 'paste again to expand'. Expected: submitted and receipted.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The fake tmux in test/adapters/projects-sessions/tracker-tmux.test.ts accepts text and Enter in one command and only models the Codex composer, so Claude's paste-burst behaviour was never modelled. The reusable fixture test/support/claudePasteTmuxFixture.ts keeps an Enter sent with text inside the paste.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
